subject: Re: Pilot demo timing — request to move until post-spend-hold
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jake Morales <jake@cedarwave.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot demo — proposed windows and agenda

Hi Jake,

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, we want to run a 45-minute pilot demo that focuses on inference latency/cost tradeoffs for your ingest profile and the Dedicated deployment options. Draft agenda attached (demo-agenda.pdf).

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Oct 27 — 10:00–10:45
- Wed Oct 28 — 14:00–14:45
- Fri Oct 30 — 09:30–10:15

Karthik (cc) will lead the walkthrough and cover technical Qs. If none of these work, tell me a rough week window and we’ll match. Also tagging procurement@cedarwave.com if there are PO/timing constraints we should account for.

Open asks:
- Confirm preferred demo length (45 vs 60)
- Any specific traffic/sequence-length examples you want us to include?

Thanks,
--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0123

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf

From: Jake Morales <jake@cedarwave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cedarwave.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — proposed windows and agenda

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the agenda. Quick heads up: our CFO is traveling the week of Oct 26–30 and FinOps has put a temporary spend hold until the FY reforecast completes. That means we can realistically schedule the live walk until folks unblock mid-November.

Two requests from my side:
1) Can we move the demo to the week of Nov 16 (any day except Wed morning)?
2) Would you be able to surface a short cost summary (ballpark committed vs burst pricing for Dedicated) so our procurement folks can start internal notes before the demo?

We'll loop our procurement contact on dates once we confirm. Sorry for the churn — this is a broad finance gating vs anything on your side.

Best,
Jake
Head of Engineering | CedarWave
jake@cedarwave.com

Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — proposed windows and agenda

Hi Jake — thanks for the update and for flagging the spend hold. Totally understand — happy to push until after your FY reforecast. A couple of small things from our side to keep momentum:

- Attached is a short pilot cost summary (pilot-cost-breakdown.xlsx) with committed vs burst scenarios across 2/4/8 GPU pools. It's high-level but should help procurement start an internal note.
- Proposed follow-up windows (week of Nov 16, PST):
  • Mon Nov 16 — 11:00–11:45
  • Thu Nov 19 — 15:00–15:45
  • Fri Nov 20 — 09:00–09:45

Karthik — can you confirm availability for Thu Nov 19? If that works we can tentatively hold Trey (our solutions engineer) and I’ll send a calendar invite with the updated agenda.

Laura — nudging in case there are any discount/approval asks we should pre-clear for a mid-November pilot. Happy to propose a one-off pilot credit if FinOps needs a soft landing.

Jake — if you'd rather leave the date flexible until procurement confirms, we can also create a tentative slot and lock once they sign off. Which would you prefer?

Best,
Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0123

Attachments: pilot-cost-breakdown.xlsx

Marissa — thanks for the cost sheet and the options. Procurement prefers we tentatively hold Thu Nov 19 at 15:00 PST and they'll confirm PO timing next week. Please go ahead and send the invite as tentative; procurement will follow up with formal PO next week.

Also: can you include a 10–15 min block at the end of the session for procurement to ask contract/retention questions? They'll want to understand data retention and audit log options.

Appreciate the flexibility. Looking forward to the walkthrough.

Cheers,
Jake
Head of Engineering | CedarWave
jake@cedarwave.com
